notes: Regression family is ambiguous: a binomial GEE with identity link yields risk differences, so it is recorded as linear with a logistic alternative. view_issues: Text calls the large central metropolitan –11.0% a highest-vs-lowest contrast, but Table 1 uses Q2 as referent there because Q1 is suppressed. The Discussion says disparities were not associated with minority status, whereas results show higher coverage in high-minority SVI counties.
